subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw define a durable per-skill runtime data contract, and if so should it be a filesystem convention, a plugin/skill SDK data API, or ClawHub authoring guidance only?
rationale: Current main has only managed skill package roots and installer tools roots; choosing a writable runtime data location changes product storage, plugin API, docs, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add a generic data contract
options.body: Define a narrow skill/plugin data API or manifest field, document it, and add install/runtime handling only after the storage owner is explicit.

options.title: Use authoring guidance only
options.body: Keep runtime unchanged and document a ClawHub skill-author convention for where community skills should place their own data.

options.title: Decline filesystem data dirs
options.body: Route persistent skill state to plugin KV or SQLite-backed APIs instead of introducing per-skill filesystem state under the OpenClaw state directory.

recommendation.title: Add a generic data contract
recommendation.body: Define a narrow skill/plugin data API or manifest field, document it, and add install/runtime handling only after the storage owner is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent ownership across skills docs, runtime documentation, and ClawHub install-flow work.
